subject: Agreement assembly & sequencing for pilot — MSA / DPA / Order Form
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Nicolas Gomez <n.gomez@elara.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@elara.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Agreement assembly & sequencing for pilot — MSA / DPA / Order Form

Hi Nicolas / Priya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I’m sharing a first-pass mutual action plan focused on sequencing the MSA, DPA, and the pilot order form so we can lock a target go-live for the October trial. The attached spreadsheet is intentionally compact: high-level milestones, owners, and the minimal evidence each lane needs for sign-off.

Key assumptions for this timeline:
- Legal (MSA) redline review and one round of back-and-forth (2 weeks)
- DPA evidence pack (SOC 2 attestation + data flow diagram) available from your security team within 4 business days to start vendor review
- Order form (pricing + invoice contact) parallelized with legal to avoid a hard stop

Ask: can you confirm who on your procurement side will own signature coordination? If we have a named contact, we can build a 3-day signature window into the MAP and open a DocuSign envelope when the MSA is agreed.

I’ve looped in Karthik (legal sequencing) and Laura (procurement handoff) — both can adjust the plan based on your constraints.

Attachments: Elara-MAP-v2.xlsx (draft), initial MSA redline will follow from Karthik.

Next steps: please review the milestones (sheet: Summary) and reply with any immovable dates or blackout windows this quarter.

Best,
David
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Elara-MAP-v2.xlsx]

From: Nicolas Gomez <n.gomez@elara.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@elara.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Agreement assembly & sequencing for pilot — MSA / DPA / Order Form

David —

Appreciate the concise MAP. A few constraints from our side:
1) Procurement will be dark 9/20–9/24 for quarter close; we can’t execute signatures during that week.
2) Our security team has a pending vendor questionnaire item: full KMS flow for third-party plugins — will try to get the evidence pack to you by 9/18 but might slip to 9/21.
3) Pricing is locked on our side but we need a single-point invoice contact to be added to the order form (Priya can provide).

If the DPA evidence slips past 9/18, can we stage the pilot as a limited-scope trial (no PII) while legal finalizes the DPA? That would allow us to start integrations and performance work.

Cc’ing procurement alias for visibility.

—Nicolas
Nicolas Gomez
Head of R&D Operations, Elara Therapeutics
<procurement@elara.com>

Date: 2026-09-18T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Agreement assembly & sequencing for pilot — MSA / DPA / Order Form

Team —

Quick legal note after my review of Elara’s baseline: I’ve prepared an MSA redline that keeps the core commercial terms intact but isolates two DPA-dependent clauses behind an evidence gate: (1) cross-border processing addendum; (2) customer-supplied key handling. Proposal:

- Leave order form execution uncoupled from final DPA sign-off by adding a conditional clause in the order form (Schedule A) that limits pilot scope if DPA evidence not delivered.
- For signature sequencing, recommend the following cadence: MSA business terms + order form signed first (DocuSign), then DPA signature within 10 business days of evidence delivery. If evidence not delivered within 10 days, the order form automatically converts to a dev-only pilot with restricted dataset.

I’ve attached the redline and a short evidence index for your security team to consume. If Elara wants to run a limited-scope pilot, legal risk is low provided we add the conditional restriction to the order form and document the fallback in the MAP.

I’ll be available tomorrow for a brief sync with Nicolas / Priya to walk through the redline and the scheduling language.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA-redline-ELR.docx]

Date: 2026-09-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Agreement assembly & sequencing for pilot — MSA / DPA / Order Form

Nicolas / Priya —

Thanks for the quick responses and the procurement blackout heads-up. I’ve consolidated Karthik’s redline approach into the MAP and updated the Summary sheet to show two parallel lanes:

1) Primary lane (full pilot): requires DPA evidence by 2026-09-21; DPA signature and MSA completed by 2026-10-05; signature window planned for 10/06–10/08.
2) Contingency lane (dev-only pilot): if evidence misses 9/21, we’ll execute order form for limited-scope pilot (no PII) and proceed with integration work. The order form will include Schedule A conditional language Karthik proposed.

Laura — can you confirm we can open a DocuSign envelope that tags the order form as conditional and routes the DPA to a second signature step? If procurement is unavailable 9/20–9/24, we’d like to plan the envelope to start 9/27 with a 3-day routed signature period for procurement.

Nicolas — once Priya confirms the invoice contact, I’ll update the order form and resend.

Next steps (owners & dates in Summary sheet):
- Priya: provide invoice contact (name + email) — due 2026-09-23 EOD
- Elara security: deliver DPA evidence pack — target 2026-09-18, fallback 2026-09-21
- Karthik: publish final redline w/ Schedule A language — done (attached)
- Laura: confirm DocuSign routing and signature windows — due 2026-09-23

I’ll attach the updated MAP and the redline to the HubSpot record and open a DocuSign envelope when Laura confirms routing.

Thanks —
David
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Elara-MAP-v2.xlsx] [Attachment: MSA-redline-ELR.docx]
